integrity.reproducibility: Seven standalone text artifacts including a dependency-free finite checker; infinite theorems supported by analytic proof, not by enumeration.

scientific_limitations: Only the random endpoint-pairing model with independent endpoints from one nonatomic law and triangle-free conditioning. First-order extremes, not centered Gumbel laws. Earlier source full-text access was incomplete; priority is qualified.
